comment: Deterministic world events (case clock / event counter, not wall-clock). Consumed by the world service in Phase 5; validated for reference integrity in Phase 2.

events.description: After the stopped clock is found, Mara withdraws to the library and will talk there.
After the muddy prints are found, Theo slips into the hall, afraid of what they mean.
After the open safe is found, Grey is summoned upstairs and waits in the hall.
